ads.name: R-v3b light: the right address for your SCO in Jind
ads.headline: The right address for your SCO in Jind
ads.text: Forteasia Flower Valley, Sector 26, Jind: SCO (G+3) and booths around a central green plaza, on the 24-metre-wide road with parking in front, inside an established township behind PGI Jind. HRERA-PKL-JND-314-2022, www.haryanarera.gov.in. Tap below to book a site visit on WhatsApp.
ads.prefill: Hi, I want to visit the Flower Valley Jind commercial plots.
